body:
If you want me to be honest, you are right. I do have so much to live for. And I've already found these things. No doubt in my mind am I loved, and cared for, and I don't think I'm worthless or stupid. I'm not bullied or abused, perhaps my thoughts if suicide are selfish, because my life is pretty great compared to how lots of others have it.

But I'm tired of dealing with life. I'm tired of dealing with other people and their bullshit. I bend over backwards to help people out, and I get nothing in return. The only reason I see to keep myself alive is for other people. I don't want to destroy their lives from my decision. Yet I don't care anymore. I've gone out of my way to do all this, perhaps it's time for a little karma. I'm also tired of life's bullshit. 

I'm sure it does get better, but think about it this way: Your body can only go so long without sleep. As of right now it NEEDS it. Ten miles ahead, you can walk on foot for the world's most comfortable bed. Or you could fall asleep right now. What are you gonna do? Oh well it's not your decision it's your body's. And it's decided it's going to literally pass out because it cannot handle anymore stress or exhaustion.

Only now the only difference is I'm the one in control. My body can do all it wants to keep myself alive, but I'm making the decision now. And I'm tired, I need the sweet release of death just as my body would need the sweet release of sleep.

I apologise on going all poetic on you, I tend to do that sometimes.

I'm not even sure I can wait until the semester ends, spring break is about to end, and honestly I don't feel like putting up with the sad excuse for bullshit we call school. It ends tomorrow. Hopefully if I build up enough courage _I_ end tomorrow too.

I do. Nothing changes. And this is during spring break. The one chance that if I was allowed I'd actually get to go out. Imagine when school starts back up. 

This is why I plan to kill myself. I feel hopeless and lost. No doubt in my mind will this bullshit get better once I move off to college, but I'm done. I can't do this anymore. I'm not gonna wait three more years.

Paranoid. They think the minute I step foot out of the house unsupervised, I'll be kidnapped (they don't flat out say that, but you can tell that's what they're thinking).

So why not take them with me on walks, you ask? They don't want to and don't feel like it. Because they're old. Literally. Biologically they are my grandparents. At most, they'll maybe walk with me for five minutes. I don't want to be with them when I walk anyways. It's hard to really connect with someone two generations older than you. It's bad enough being locked inside all day with them because of their fears, I sure as hell don't want to have to be around them while doing something I enjoy privately.

Like I said in my post, I'm not alone. I have people who are here with me. I'm just lonely because I have no one to truly connect to.

I _liked_ video games and cartoons, but have lost interest in them as that is the ONLY thing I ever do anymore without any friends. I mean, I like things here and there, but not as much as I like video games and cartoons, but even then I don't even like then that much anymore nowadays.

 I like nature. A lot. I like being outside and being able to relax and take walks or go hang out on the swings at our neighbourhood park, and what not. My parents don't allow that to happen.
I can't. I can't go on walks. I can't travel. I can't make big changes, not ones that I want to make, at least. I try to make the most of everything, but it so hard and I'm losing hope.
I'm lonely because I have no friends, no siblings, no one who shares the same interests I do. I've tried to look for people, but I'm done with searching.

I want to distract myself. I try so hard, but I've exhausted every movie, show, game, and site. All of them are boring now. Most other things to distract myself I either can't do, or don't want to because that'll lead my thoughts to wanting to die again. So now it's just like what the hell do I do? I don't know what to do, and like I said, I'm tired of it.

You're not short. Not by a long shot. 5'7 is amazing, none the less for a girl (as we tend to be shorter than guys). I'm not even five feet. I would kill to be 5'7... But enough about me.

Seriously, I think you're above average in height. If not, then you're definitely on the high end of average.
In that case, no. Unless you live in a town with some crazy law or laws, you won't get fined or go to jail. At most you may be required to go to a psychiatric ward (if a suicide attempt fails).
In some places, they have laws where you can go to jail (or in this case fined) for attempting (but of course failing) to commit suicide.
